hints.title: Interval Illumination Coverage
hints.text: A street light at position p with range r illuminates every integer coordinate from p minus r to p plus r inclusive.

hints.title: Difference Array Boundary Points
hints.text: Mark start coordinate p minus r with plus one and coordinate p plus r plus one with minus one.

hints.title: Sweep-Line Prefix Accumulation
hints.text: Sort all transition points and sweep in ascending order, tracking the peak brightness and its earliest coordinate.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def brightestPosition(self, lights: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        diff = defaultdict(int)
        for p, r in lights:
            diff[p - r] += 1
            diff[p + r + 1] -= 1
        best_pos = None
        max_bright = -1
        curr = 0
        for pos in sorted(diff.keys()):
            curr += diff[pos]
            if curr > max_bright:
                max_bright = curr
                best_pos = pos
        return best_pos
```

complexity.time: O(L log L) sorting the 2 * L boundary points where L is the number of streetlights
complexity.space: O(L) hash table storing coordinate difference deltas
variables: L: number of street light fixtures
complexity.notes: Line sweep discretizes infinite coordinate range to transition events only.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating over coordinate ranges directly causes memory and time timeout on 10^9 coordinates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sparse coordinate difference map runs in event-bounded time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement coordinate compression difference array with tie-breaking for earliest position.
